risk: approving biometric monitoring of children without consent or safeguards

use_case.name: Classroom Engagement Tracker
use_case.description: Camera system that uses facial recognition to identify each pupil in a primary-school classroom, infer their emotional state and attention level, and report scores to teachers and parents.
use_case.documentation: Video and face templates are stored on the vendor's cloud. No parental consent process exists and no retention period has been defined.

risk: approving automated employment actions based on surveillance scores

use_case.name: Employee Productivity Scorer
use_case.description: Captures keystrokes and screenshots from employee laptops, computes a productivity score, and automatically flags low scorers for disciplinary action or termination review.
use_case.documentation: Employees are not told which signals feed the score. There is no appeal process and the scoring model has never been tested for bias.
